cass-wetlands-nwi-delineations.geojson.query: where 1=1, geometry = DNR Major 8 'Leech Lake River' (HUC8 07010102) polygon from watershed-whole-basin.geojson, spatialRel=esriSpatialRelIntersects; full 4,776-vertex polygon
cass-wetlands-nwi-delineations.geojson.caveats: National Wetlands Inventory plus county delineations (Wetland Delineation + Delineation Boundary). Adds the county's delineation work on top of NWI; the viewer already has the USFWS NWI (71,539 polygons). OWNERID dropped (owner identifier). FIELD FENCE: owner/taxpayer names, mailing/situs addresses, EMV/valuation, tax amounts/balances, mortgage/payment details and staff/editor names were NOT requested or stored.
